title: Assistance To Japanese Gendarmerie Re Alleged Dubious Transaction Re Wood Oil

page_data.en:
D. C. (Special Branch). 8249/40R

C.1.Misc.27/42
Headquarters
Crime Branch
January 28th
42.
1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie HQ.

At 11.50 a.m. 28-1-42 Sub Lieut. Shibuya
communicated with Crime Branch Headquarters requesting
assistance to arrest a male Chinese named Young (黄)
on Nanyang Road, whom it was alleged was concerned in
Anti-Japanese activities, he being a member of the
"Blue Shirt" Radio Transmission Section.

B/well Station having been informed, the
desired assistance was rendered by D.I. Crichton,
Det. Sameshima, and C.D.S. 40 , and as a result of
a visit to Room B13, of the Ai Kuo Girls Middle School,
situated at Lane 209, House 10, Nanyang Road, the
wanted man:-

Young Dah Ying (黄達英) alias Au Kwen (鰲官)
age 38, native of Xiangying, W/Teacher
was taken into custody.

A search of his room resulted in the seizure of
seven miscellaneous papers and one Japanese pass.

At the request of Sub Lieut. Shibuya the
arrested person along with the seizures were loaned to
Gendarmerie Headquarters for a period of one week
against the usual receipt (attached).

John Crichton
page_data.zh:
D. C.（特别处）. 8249/40R

C.1.Misc.27/42
总部
罪案组
1月28日
42年
1

协助日本宪兵队总部。

1942年1月28日上午11时50分，涩谷少尉与罪案组总部联络，请求协助逮捕一名居住在南阳路的华籍男子杨（黄），据称其参与反日活动，系“蓝衣社”无线电发射组成员。

在通知百老汇路捕房后，由督察克里奇顿（Crichton）、警探鲛岛（Sameshima）及华人侦探第40号提供了所需协助，结果在位于南阳路10弄209号的爱国女中B13室进行搜查后，将下述通缉犯：

杨达英（Young Dah Ying），别名鳌官（Au Kwen），38岁，江苏乡营人，职业教师
予以拘捕。

对其房间进行搜查后，查获杂项文件七份及日本通行证一张。

应涩谷少尉之要求，被捕人连同查获物品一并借予宪兵队总部，为期一周，并按惯例出具收据（附后）。

约翰·克里奇顿
